label: apologise
note: The RESPONSE to an apology is taught -- 'kaahii harkat naahii', MR-C03-kaahi-harkat-nahi, schema-v1 -- and the apology itself is not, in either schema: maaf karaa and kshamaa karaa appear nowhere. A candidate who can only forgive and never apologise is the wrong half of SPINE-POLITE-REQUEST-REPAIR.
